failure_report_text: I dont know what happened after tests, but I was wrong. Some inputs completely cut the connection from the controller. At least pressing rf5 or rf6 disconnect it according to the game console
recovery_report_text: i restored the previous fw, which works fine still

hypotheses.title: Global/static initialization or const parse result memory/runtime interaction
evidence: Failed activation branch adds namespace-scope kPhase7ACompiledPayloadParseResult initialized by ParseUltimateRuntimeConfigPayload.
ResolveActiveRuntimeConfig gates runtime view selection on that parse result.
No debugger, map-file, watchdog, or USB trace evidence proves a low-level cause.
hypotheses.proposed_next_check: Avoid a persistent global runtime ParseResult or prove object placement and initialization before hardware activation.

hypotheses.title: Static memory/layout pressure from 530-byte compiled payload or parser code
evidence: Failed activation branch adds a 530-byte compiled payload array and active parser gate.
No inspected artifact proves RAM/flash pressure or report/USB corruption.
This remains a risk note, not a diagnosis.
hypotheses.proposed_next_check: Compare firmware size/map output between configurator and a minimal activation probe before hardware testing.

hypotheses.title: Activation boundary changed lifetime/reference behavior
evidence: UpdateAnalogOutputs changed from direct ValidateRuntimeConfigView selection to ResolveActiveRuntimeConfig.
Resolved references still point at source-owned static runtime views.
No payload-backed table lifetime or pointer ownership was introduced.
hypotheses.proposed_next_check: Keep runtime view selection identical to configurator until validation is proven outside the output path.

hypotheses.title: Parser validation path triggered unexpected embedded-runtime behavior
evidence: Parser path is newly active in firmware and gates active runtime config selection.
Parser source does not show mutation, storage access, or output-path side effects.
The parse result is global rather than recomputed on RF5/RF6 press.
hypotheses.proposed_next_check: Prefer host/build-time equivalence checks or compile-time diagnostics before a runtime parser gate.

hypotheses.title: Unrelated but activation-branch-specific interaction
evidence: Recovery report isolates regression to the activation branch.
No hardware instrumentation isolates the RF5/RF6 disconnect to a specific low-level mechanism.
Static analysis alone cannot eliminate all branch-specific interactions.
hypotheses.proposed_next_check: Start a new minimal branch from configurator with one bounded activation change and a hardware gate.

caveats: do not infer firmware crash mechanism without debugging
configurator baseline restored and works fine
failed activation branch must not merge
future runtime activation requires hardware gate
